subject: Learning Methods
title: Caffeine: Friend and Foe
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Caffeine: Friend and Foe.

hook.text: Caffeine blocks adenosine, the molecule that makes you feel sleepy. For a few hours, alertness sharpens noticeably.

buildup.text: Moderate caffeine improves attention and reaction time. It is the most widely used cognitive enhancer in the world.

discovery.text: The effect peaks 30 to 60 minutes after consumption and lasts four to six hours depending on metabolism.

twist.text: Tolerance builds within two weeks. You then need caffeine just to reach your normal baseline, not to exceed it.

climax.text: Use caffeine strategically for peak study sessions, not constantly. Cycling on and off preserves its power.

punchline.text: Use caffeine as a tool, not a crutch. Cycle it wisely.

quiz.question: Why does caffeine lose effectiveness with daily use?
options: Your liver processes it faster over time
Tolerance builds and you need it just to feel normal
Caffeine molecules change shape after repeated exposure
